question: Which team won the 3 rd edition of the Women's Premier League in 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**Mumbai Indians**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Mumbai Indians** emerged as the champions of the **3rd edition of the Women's Premier League (WPL) in 2025**. • The team, owned by **Reliance Industries**, has been one of the most consistent franchises in both the men's and women's formats of the game. • Mumbai Indians displayed exceptional performance throughout the tournament with a blend of experienced players and young talents. • The team was led by **Harmanpreet Kaur**, one of India’s finest cricketers, who played a pivotal role in guiding the team to victory. • The final match was a thrilling encounter, and the team showcased outstanding skills in all departments – batting, bowling, and fielding – to secure the title.
